description:
Live battery monitoring for wireless mice, keyboards, headsets and controllers on Windows.

Battery Hub reads the battery level of wireless HID peripherals — mice, keyboards, headsets and game controllers — and shows them on a single dashboard with a per-device indicator in the system tray and low-battery notifications. Devices with no known protocol can be set up through a guided calibration wizard that identifies which byte of the HID report carries the battery level, so support is not limited to a fixed list of models. Runs entirely locally and collects no user data.
The biggest device update yet: about 330 new devices, found in open-source projects and the makers' own apps. Thank you to everyone who sent a report!
New devices
- Headsets: Sony INZONE H5 and H9 II; Razer Kraken V4 / V4 Pro, BlackShark V2 HyperSpeed, V3 X and V2 Pro, Nari; SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni, Nova Elite and GameBuds; HyperX Cloud Alpha 2, Cloud Core and more Cloud models; Corsair HS80 RGB and Virtuoso XT; Logitech G325 and G PRO X 2; Jabra, Poly, JBL Quantum 810/910, Lenovo; ASUS ROG Strix Go and TUF H3; Audeze; Skullcandy; FIFINE HT6
- Mice: Razer Basilisk V4 Pro / HyperSpeed, Naga V3 Pro, Orochi V2; Pulsar, G-Wolves, Endgame Gear XM2we, WLmouse; SteelSeries Aerox 3 Gen 2, Rival 650 and Rival Pro; ASUS ROG and TUF mice; HyperX Pulsefire Haste 2 and Dart; Corsair SABRE v3 PRO and more Slipstream mice; NZXT, VAXEE, Cooler Master, MSI VERSA PRO, Ninjutso, Darmoshark, Rapoo and more
- Keyboards: ASUS ROG Azoth, Falchion and Strix Scope; Corsair K65, K70 and K100; MCHOSE K87 and G98 Pro; AULA F108 Pro; Lofree Flow; Alienware Pro; CHERRY MX 3.0S; Red Square; SteelSeries Apex Pro; Razer BlackWidow V4 Low Profile
- Controllers: Flydigi Vader and Apex, 8BitDo Ultimate 2 and 3, Steam Controller, NVIDIA SHIELD, Amazon Luna
- From the makers' own web apps: more VGN, MCHOSE, ATK, Pulsar and MonsGeek / Epomaker devices
Many of these were tested on hardware by the projects we learned them from, but not by us, so please tell us how yours does.

Fixed
- VSG Aquila Fly and Redragon M913 showed a tenth of the level, and never showed "fully charged".
- MCHOSE V9 PRO is read while charging or full.
- Corsair Slipstream receivers and mice on Compx fa09 receivers are read the right way.
- Razer BlackWidow V3 Pro on its cable.

Faster
- The app reads devices that answered last time first, so one silent device no longer holds up the others, and it does far less disk work on every check.
